usage: 單車機 is a noun used to refer to a stationary exercise bike found in gyms or homes.
You can use 單車機 as the subject or object in a sentence, e.g., 我買咗部單車機 (I bought an exercise bike).
When describing activities, 單車機 usually works with verbs like 騎 (ride) or 做 (do).
You can add descriptive words before 單車機 to specify the type, such as 家用單車機 (home exercise bike).
To talk about frequency, time expressions can be used, e.g., 我每日用單車機十五分鐘 (I use the exercise bike for fifteen minutes daily).
